"Congratulations, sir," Ramesh said, bowing. "Manager Jatin. Will you still eat at the roadside stall with us poor people?"

Jatin laughed but felt the edge. "Stop it. I'm still the guy who owes you forty rupees from class ten."

"Forty-five, with interest."

"Fine. Chai's on me tonight, and you choose the place."

Ramesh shrugged. "I heard they gave you a car allowance too."

"Just the title, honestly. I got lucky that the other manager left." Jatin paused. "How did the interview go? You said you had one last week."

"They said they'd call."

"Call me before you go in next time. I'll drill you on the tough questions, like you did for my board practicals."

Ramesh looked away, then smiled. "Fine. Bring the notes."

qa.q: How much does Jatin say he owes Ramesh from class ten?
qa.a: Jatin says he owes forty rupees, which Ramesh corrects to forty-five with interest.

qa.q: What does Ramesh's "poor people" line suggest about how Ramesh feels?
qa.a: It suggests a sour mix of envy and hurt at Jatin's new status, hidden behind teasing.

qa.q: How does Jatin keep the friendship steady?
qa.a: Jatin stays humble by playing down the promotion, brings up shared history, and offers to pay for chai and help Ramesh prepare for the interview.

qa.q: Why might Ramesh have looked away before smiling?
qa.a: Ramesh may have felt stung about the job hunt while still being touched by Jatin's offer of help.

grounding: A friend congratulates Jatin with a sour edge; Jatin stays humble, anchors in shared history, gives space and offers to help with the friend's own goal.

passage:
I'm Tejas. When I got the promotion to team lead last year, Lalremsiami was the first to text: "Congrats, boss!" with a row of party emojis.

But over the next few weeks, something shifted. At lunch she'd say, "Oh, sorry, sir, I'll let you speak first." Everyone laughed. When I mentioned the new laptop, she said, "Must be nice."

It stung. We'd started at the company on the same day, eaten the same bad canteen food for three years.

My first instinct was to pull rank or pull away. Instead I stopped mentioning anything new: the laptop, the meetings with directors. I kept going to our Friday momo place, same table, same order. I didn't push her to talk.

A month later, she got a big client win. I made sure the director heard about it, and I bought the momos.

She laughed properly that day. "Okay," she said. "You're still you."

qa.q: What did Lalremsiami first text Tejas?
qa.a: "Congrats, boss!" with a row of party emojis.

qa.q: What was Tejas feeling when Lalremsiami teased about the promotion?
qa.a: Tejas felt stung and hurt, since they had started at the company together and shared years of canteen food.

qa.q: What did Tejas do that kept the friendship alive?
qa.a: Tejas stopped showing off, kept the Friday momo tradition, gave Lalremsiami space, and celebrated her client win with the director.

qa.q: What might have been behind Lalremsiami's teasing?
qa.a: Lalremsiami may have felt envious and left behind after starting on the same day as Tejas.

grounding: The reflective account shows someone whose old friend turns sour after a promotion, staying humble, keeping shared history alive, giving space and celebrating the friend's wins.

passage:
Cricket coach's note, Sunday veterans' nets

Abhinav and Asif have opened the batting together for our club since they were fifteen. This season, Abhinav got selected for the state corporate team. Today was his first week back at our nets since.

I noticed Asif greet him with "Oh, the star has arrived!" loud enough for everyone. Twice more he made jokes: "Careful, don't bowl too fast at the famous man." Abhinav's smile looked tight.

Abhinav handled it well. He didn't talk about the state team at all. He asked Asif about his daughter's school admission. At the break he brought out the same flask of cutting chai they've shared since school days.

Later I heard Abhinav quietly tell Asif, "Your cover drive's better than mine. Always has been." Asif looked away, but I saw him smile.

Next step: I've put them back as openers for next Sunday's friendly, and asked Abhinav to help coach the juniors with Asif.

Coach

qa.q: What team was Abhinav selected for?
What does Abhinav's tight smile suggest about how he felt?
qa.a: It suggests Abhinav felt hurt and uncomfortable at Asif's teasing, even while staying polite.

qa.q: What did Abhinav do to keep the friendship steady?
qa.a: Abhinav avoided showing off, asked about Asif's daughter, shared their old chai, and praised Asif's cover drive.

qa.q: How might Asif be feeling about Abhinav's selection?
qa.a: Asif may feel envious and left behind, masking it with loud jokes, but he is touched by the praise.

grounding: A coach's note shows someone whose old friend teases him sourly after a success, staying humble, keeping the friendship anchored in shared history and praising the friend.
